senses.gloss:
फु(फू)त् ind. An onomatopoetic word generally used in composition
 with कृ, and imitative of the sound made by blowing into liquids &c.;
 sometimes it expresses disregard or contempt; फु(फू)त्कृ
—1 To blow into (a liquid); बालः पायसदग्धो दध्यपि फूत्कृत्य भक्षयति H. 4. 103.
—2 To scream aloud, cry, shriek.
.━{@Comp.@}: फुत्कारः, फुत्कृतम्, फुत्कृतिः, फुत्कृत, फुत्कृतिः

फुत् + -कारः, -कृतम्, -कृतिः f.
—1 blowing into.
—2 hissing, whizzing.
—3 the hiss of a serpent.
—4 sobbing.
—5 screaming, a loud shriek, yell. फूत्काररन्ध्रम् the hole of a flute.

फुत् + -कृत + .({@-तम्@})
—1 the sound of a wind-instrument.
—2 a loud cry, shriek, scream.

फुत् + -कारः, -कृतम्, -कृतिः f.
—1 blowing into.
—2 hissing, whizzing.
—3 the hiss of a serpent.
—4 sobbing.

फुत् + -कृतिः
—1 the blowing of a wind instrument.
—2 blowing, hissing.
—3 crying aloud.

फुत् + -कृत a.
—1 blown into &c.
—2 blown up (as a bubble.)
—3 screamed aloud.
